name: Partial Differential Equations
description: Solve the heat equation and turn the Black-Scholes equation into it.

lessonNames.l9-black-scholes-to-heat: Turning Black-Scholes into the heat equation
lessonNames.l10-formula-from-the-kernel: The Black-Scholes formula from the heat kernel
lessonNames.l12-four-decimal-pricer: A finite-difference pricer to four decimals

lessonObjectives.l1-equations-in-two-variables: Classify a partial differential equation by order and type.
lessonObjectives.l2-heat-equation: Derive the heat equation from a random walk and check a solution.
lessonObjectives.l3-heat-kernel: Solve the heat equation on the line with the heat kernel, a normal density.
lessonObjectives.l4-boundary-conditions: Pose a well-posed problem with initial and boundary conditions.
lessonObjectives.l5-separation-of-variables: Split a partial differential equation into two ordinary ones by separation of variables.
lessonObjectives.l6-fourier-series: Compute a function’s Fourier coefficients and plot partial sums.
lessonObjectives.l7-when-fourier-converges: See where a Fourier series converges and the overshoot at a jump.
lessonObjectives.l8-heat-on-a-rod: Solve the heat equation on an interval with a Fourier series.
lessonObjectives.l9-black-scholes-to-heat: Change variables to turn the Black-Scholes equation into the heat equation.
lessonObjectives.l10-formula-from-the-kernel: Recover the Black-Scholes formula by solving the heat equation with the heat kernel.
lessonObjectives.l11-feynman-kac: Use Feynman-Kac to write a pricing equation’s solution as an expectation, and check it by simulation.
lessonObjectives.l12-four-decimal-pricer: Match a Crank-Nicolson price to the closed form to four decimal places.
